description: ODM2 is a community information model and set of database schemas for spatially discrete Earth observations from sensors and samples. CUAHSI and the ODM2 team publish scripts for creating Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite databases, plus documentation and hydrological use cases. The GitHub repository is freely accessible under a three-clause BSD-style licence whose text names the team and CUAHSI. These globally applicable schemas can organise water-quality and flow observations before calibration of infrastructure simulations. Example mappings cover Little Bear River and Puget Sound. ODM2 stores observations, not simulating flows itself, and untested database deployment is a limitation. No directly related catalogue platform was identified.
name: Observations Data Model 2
